vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: list_voices reports the allowed models with their voices, defaults and style support, which the vision names as part of the tool contract.

conops.paraphrase: Claude checks once with list_voices that the chosen model and voice are allowed before narrating.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Validation before any spend refuses an unknown model with an ERROR that names the fix.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway validates the model is allowed before any clip is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Validation before any spend refuses a voice the model does not have, with an ERROR naming the fix.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway checks the voice is known before any clip is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Voice names are matched case-insensitively so a skill's spelling does not cause a needless refusal.

conops.paraphrase: Claude passes the house voice name in the synthesize call, which must be accepted as written in any case.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: A call containing a clip with no text is refused before any spend, with an ERROR naming the clip.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway checks each clip's length bounds before any clip is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: A call with more than 40 clips is refused before any spend, with an ERROR naming the limit and how to split.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway enforces the 1 to 40 clips per call limit before any clip is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: A clip over 4,000 characters is refused before any spend, with an ERROR naming the clip and the fix.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway enforces the per-clip character limit before any clip is synthesized.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: The limits of 40 clips and 4,000 characters are the documented maximums, so a call exactly at them must succeed.

conops.paraphrase: The per-call limits are inclusive, so a call at the boundary is accepted.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Stdio server
vision.paraphrase: The test model fake/tone is accepted only by the stdio server and must be refused by the gateway, so it cannot spend real credit.

conops.paraphrase: The gateway refuses the fake test model, while the stdio server accepts it for offline style testing.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G1 requires a signed-in user with no personal key to get a full spine of clips from the gateway.

conops.paraphrase: Claude calls synthesize_narration with the whole spine and the caller holds no OpenRouter key.

vision.section: §9 — Design Direction
vision.paraphrase: Tool results pair a human summary with one fenced JSON block holding the per-clip fields that the skill scripts read.

conops.paraphrase: The result carries a fenced JSON block with the per-clip fields the skill needs.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: The result summary states the call's cost, cached count and median wpm, so the user sees what the call did.

conops.paraphrase: The markdown part of the result gives a one-line summary of clips, cached count, cost and median wpm.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G5 keeps audio out of the model's context, so the tool result carries only metadata and URLs.

conops.paraphrase: The result carries per-clip metadata and URLs rather than audio bytes.

vision.section: §5 — Goals & Success Criteria (MVP)
vision.paraphrase: Goal G4 requires one progress notification per clip during a long spine call, visible in Claude Code.

conops.paraphrase: After each clip the gateway sends a progress notification that Claude Code shows to the user.

vision.section: §10 — Data Strategy
vision.paraphrase: Audio comes from OpenRouter as 16-bit mono 24 kHz PCM and is wrapped in a WAV header before it is cached.

conops.paraphrase: On a miss the gateway wraps the returned PCM in a WAV header before storing it.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: The per-clip word count and wpm measure spoken words, so mood tags are excluded from the count.

conops.paraphrase: The per-clip words and wpm reported in the result must describe the spoken text.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: The result summary warns about slow clips below 70% of the median wpm, which usually means a mood tag was read aloud.

conops.paraphrase: The result's markdown includes any slow-clip warning alongside the summary line.

vision.section: §10 — Data Strategy
vision.paraphrase: Each uncached clip is requested from OpenRouter's speech endpoint in PCM format, which the data strategy names as the audio source.

conops.paraphrase: On a cache miss the gateway calls OpenRouter with PCM output and zero data retention.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: The style is an instruction for Gemini voices and is not sent to MAI voices, which the vision's model-specific behavior implies.

conops.paraphrase: The house style is part of the synthesize call, and it applies only where the model accepts it.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Each clip may carry its own optional style, and that clip style overrides the call-level style.

conops.paraphrase: The clips in the call carry the spine's text, and a per-clip style is honored within the same call.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Each clip gets one automatic retry on a timeout or 5xx answer before the call fails.

conops.paraphrase: A timed-out clip is retried once by the gateway before the call gives up.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: When a clip still fails after its retry, the call fails with an ERROR that names the clip, and finished clips stay saved.

conops.paraphrase: The call returns an error naming the failed clip and saying that the clips already made are saved.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Narration tools (gateway and stdio)
vision.paraphrase: Only timeouts and 5xx answers are retried, so an out-of-credit answer is reported at once without a second attempt.

conops.paraphrase: A 402 from OpenRouter is not retried and returns an ERROR asking an administrator to add credit.

vision.section: §6 — MVP Scope Summary / Cross-cutting Concerns
vision.paraphrase: Keys must never appear in messages or logs, so a rejected key is reported without revealing it.

conops.paraphrase: A 401 from OpenRouter returns an ERROR asking an administrator to check the key, and the key never appears in the message.
